metadata.quote: The way infectious diseases have begun to come back shows that we remain caught in the web of life - permanently and irretrievably- no matter how clever we are at altering what we do not like, or how successful we become at displacing other species.

sections.text: Voiceover: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.title: COV-2 Has Natural Origin

sections.text: Science-Based Medicine: Cannabinoids for Acute Pain[4]
sections.title: Cannabinoids for Acute Pain

sections.title: Why Do Females Outlive Males?

sections.text: Voiceover: It's time for Science or Fiction.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: Item #1: A new study finds that learning through VR was no different in outcome from traditional computer or hands-on learning methods.[6]Item #2: The results of a new study suggest that snake venom evolved largely for hunting prey, and not self-defense.[7]Item #3: A new study finds that renewable energy plants can be placed safely in protected regions with little environmental impact.[8]

The way infectious diseases have begun to come back shows that we remain caught in the web of life–permanently and irretrievably–no matter how clever we are at altering what we do not like, or how successful we become at displacing other species.– William H. McNeill, historian
—and until next week, this is your  Skeptics' Guide to the Universe.
